notes.F11: Hemvagen black on white identifies road name, not a destination distance.
notes.F12: Dalalven above waves names the watercourse, not an access instruction.
notes.F14: Solid-border green E4 is the route itself; dashed-border variant would mean approach toward it.
notes.F15: Blue58 on white is permanent numbered diversion, unlike orange temporary signs.
notes.F16: Left branch opens a new lane on left, not a lane closing.
notes.F17: Left lane curves into remaining forward lane; reduction is not E15 general merge illustration.
notes.F18: Down arrow left and two up arrows right state opposing/forward lane layout.
notes.F19: Joining branch on right with acceleration lane does not grant unconditional entry priority.
notes.F20: Right joining road has its own lane alongside two existing lanes.
notes.F21: Dashed lane divisions and left/ahead/right arrows guide lane choice before junction.
notes.F22: SVERIGE and EU stars identify the named border without a customs-stop instruction.
notes.F23: Orange bypass diagram routes around temporary closure, distinct from permanent58 diversion.
notes.F24: Blank orange right-pointing panel gives temporary diversion direction.
notes.F25: Orange two-forward-lane diagram closes left into right where another same-direction lane remains.
notes.F26: Orange down/up arrows with blockage above up arrow mean no other lane in that direction available.
notes.F27: Yellow75 with interchange symbol is interchange number, not route75 or speed75.
notes.F28: Roof above P identifies parking garage; availability/conditions require separate information.
notes.F29: P+T indicates public transport connection, without promising free parking or travel.
notes.F30: Black ring denotes local loop/ring road, not roundabout priority.
notes.F31: White lorry on rectangular blue is suitable route guidance, not mandatory bus-lane or access prohibition.
notes.F31a: Long combination and34.5m identify designated long-combination route; not unconditional permission for every combination.
notes.F32: Orange-plate symbol on orange recommends dangerous-goods route; distinguish D12 requirement and C9 prohibition.
notes.F33: Red R1 oval identifies numbered rescue place at works, not hospital or ordinary stopping bay.
notes.F34: Bicycle and Centrum right arrow guide walking/cycling users, not general car traffic.
